title: Foundations & Core Principles
blurb: Understand what design patterns are, the 1994 GoF catalog, UML notation, and foundational OO principles.

title: SOLID Principles
blurb: Master Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion in TypeScript.

title: Creational: Factory Patterns
blurb: Decouple client code from concrete constructors using Factory Method and Abstract Factory product families.

title: Creational: Object Assembly
blurb: Construct complex objects step-by-step with Builder, clone prototypes, and manage instances with Singleton.

title: Structural: Adapters & Bridges
blurb: Reconcile incompatible interfaces with Adapter and decouple abstractions from platform implementations with Bridge.

title: Structural: Composition & Decorators
blurb: Compose uniform tree hierarchies with Composite and wrap dynamic behaviors transparently with Decorator.

title: Structural: Facades, Flyweights & Proxies
blurb: Simplify complex subsystems with Facade, optimize memory with Flyweight, and control access with Proxy.

title: Behavioral: Request Handling
blurb: Pass requests down chains with Chain of Responsibility and encapsulate operations as objects with Command.

title: Behavioral: Coordination & Events
blurb: Decouple components with Mediator, capture undo state with Memento, and broadcast updates with Observer.

title: Behavioral: Algorithms & State
blurb: Interchange runtime algorithms with Strategy, alter behavior on state change with State, and define algorithm skeletons with Template Method.

title: Behavioral: Traversal & Operations
blurb: Traverse complex collections with Iterator, evaluate grammar trees with Interpreter, and execute operations across hierarchies with Visitor.

title: Architecture, Selection & Anti-Patterns
blurb: Select appropriate patterns based on problem forces, refactor toward patterns incrementally, and eliminate toxic anti-patterns.
